name: Susanna Willoughby (Shoush)
sources: Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, compiled by William W. "Bill" Allen (2 April 2011 edition)
notes: Parent of Anna Elizabeth Shoush (Anthony): inferred, not stated. Bill Allen’s document shows photos captioned "William Shoush" and "Susanna Willoughby Shoush" together on its Allen family photo pages (page 111); Anna is the only Shoush in the family.
